notes.title: New minigame up to 1.000 players!
notes.content:
This game is designed to find the person who knows you best as a streamer. More than 100 questions focused on you and your personal tastes.

This game allows up to 1,000 players and is ideal for giveaways or contests where true fans have more chances to win.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/e9968c184f6364b7e8441e4225eb5f87051a1506.png

There are questions of all kinds to suit your interests or the mood you are in that day:
- Innocents.
- Daily routine.
- Deeper thoughts.
- Geek opinions.
- And even the most absurd ones!

You can select only the categories that fit your content, create your own custom question packs, or ask your followers to make a pack for you.
You can create a quiz with questions about your latest project or your favorite series.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/e5c8308eae31a42a770bac0e5ddf8a022aab217b.png

notes.title: Dungeon raid game has been updated.
notes.content:
Smol but highly relevant update in Kukoro dungeons!
😫Nerf: Berserk & Taunter. 
😎Buff: Rogue & Bard. 
🏆!Champion command: available for the champion on any stream. 
🎯!Focus command: available to optimize your strategies.
📅Highscores are now reseted monthly.

😎 Roles

When a viewer reaches level 20, he can unlock a new role. This roles force your abilities to point a specific type of gameplay, like healing or defense.

Berserk: Based on empowering first and last hits has been nerfed.
Taunter: Based on first hit and running away has been nerfed.
Rogue: Based on crit. attacks has been buffed. (Crits. are amazing to break into defensive enemies)
Bard: Based on healing your team and yourself has been buffed.


🏆!Champion command

When a streamer defeats the last champion, he will place himself as the new champion for the next contendants. But now !champion command has been added.

This command allows the champion to get into others' stream as a new enemy by typing !champion in their chat and flex his power.

🎯!Focus command

Now all viewers with the game can change their targets before the game starts. This will allow you to focus your abilities to the most relevant enemy or distribute your team objectives into a more strategic gameplay.

If you have crit. abilities, you can change your objective to a defensive enemy like a Gargoyle. If one of your teammates reduces agility, face him into bats, the quickest enemy.

This command is only available before the game starts.


MORE INFO
https://heynaugames.com/how-to-master-dungeon-raid-game-kukoro-stream-chat-games

notes.title: EMPOWERING STREAMERS' DISCOVERY
notes.content:
Kukoro has always prided itself on being a community-based game. That's why we have recently implemented some changes, such as disabling the AFK mode in the Kukoro category, in an effort to maintain a cleaner and more active Twitch category for all viewers.
With this, we have noticed that it can be challenging at times to find online streamers across different categories, so we have decided to create a 🌟new discovery panel🌟

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/573a02a2afd423abb2507f01a034135c601fc834.png


NEW FEATURES OF THE PANEL:
Our intention with this new panel is for you to discover channels where you can play Kukoro. To achieve this, we aim to enhance the following features:

📸 Prioritize players who are currently live.
🌍 Highlight their language and viewer count so you can choose according to your preferences.
👩‍❤️‍👩 Show how many times you've played together, encouraging you to repeat if the experience was positive.

📆 Additionally, you can see all the streamers who have played in the last 24 hours in case you missed any you want to follow for upcoming games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/c7b5cf15459fbe602f5c5262deaee4aecc88ac53.png


GOTTA CATCH 'EM ALL!
All this system, is gamified with the new Favorites column where you can add up to 20 of your favorite streamers, or those in your unattainable top 😎
If you want to catch the trendiest streamer, you must be attentive to add them on the same day they play, turning the biggest streamers into something like collectible creatures 🦄

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/3f9a2d1e501cd466470b497e6ba1a37e3025cfc4.png


WHAT DO WE WANT TO ACHIEVE WITH THIS NEW LAYOUT?
The main purpose of this panel is to grow the Kukoro community by facilitating social connections 💞
We hope that featuring your favorite streamers will help them gain discovery by other Kukoro players, creating larger and healthier communities. This, in turn, may encourage more streamers from various languages to stream the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/79dfd41c4f66d3a3019fbae1790abeaa336b85f7.png


WE ARE LISTENING
Whether you are a viewer or a streamer, we would love to hear your feedback on this feature. It was relatively improvised as there are many things beyond our control, so we would appreciate your input if you feel something is awkward or inconvenient to use. It would also be great if you notice any changes in your audience, whether it increases📈 or decreases📉 when you play Kukoro, so we can work on enhancing specific aspects of these new features.

Thank you very much for continuing to play Kukoro!
Nau😁

notes.title: Kukoro has now up to 14 Twitch chat mini-games
notes.content:
Whether you are a Streamer or a Viewer, Kukoro is for you. Collect skins, pets, dances, emotions and use them in your favorite streams. And always have a reserved spot in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/0912e4d44cb3a4c975dfc67575210eec1f394d0a.png

Kukoro already has more than 14 different mini-games to interact with your audience. All these games are based on basic principles:

- Highlight players as unique individuals, creating a healthier and closer community.
- Sense of progress, unlocking new skins, pets and customization for both the Streamer and the viewers who own the game.

- No randomness. This is a game: skill and decision making are a fundamental part of it.

- Mission system for those who want a challenge, where you can unlock unique skins and pets by playing in your stream or anyone else's thanks to account linking.

- Referral system: Kukoro is a very low priced game that tries to be accessible to all viewers, not just the streamer. If you get your audience to buy the game, you will receive a unique and personalized look for you and your audience. A tribe skin designed by you!

notes.title: Get now your Creator's code!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/a42b40be6ccdea63c25204e3bc4141634e772fbb.png

Through the creator system, you can now highlight your favorite creator: the one you play with the most or the one who encouraged you to buy the game.

Add your referral pressing “Creator’s code” button in the Log in menu. Please, note that you will only be able to enter one name and this cannot be changed in the future.

Thanks to this system, Streamers with the healthiest communities will get a customized reward:
- 25 referrals: A customized skin.
- 50 referrals: A customized pet.

Contact to kukoro@heynaugames.com when you reach the goal and I will develop an EXCLUSIVE SKIN which can only be accessed by you and your referrals.

You will be able to invade other channels with your audience wearing the exclusive uniform of your channel!
